data.exact_reserve_text: In 2017, there has been an overall deficit of GBP 1.8m on prior year reserves (2016:surplus GBP 0.7m). This has been primarily generated by the reduction in premium on casualty reinsurance class of business.

prior_year_events.event_name: Commutation of a material US Casualty contract
prior_year_events.impact_description: Commutation removed a significant amount of reserve risk from the year and was completed at a profit.

named_events.loss_description: Our estimated net exposure to these events (referred to as HIM) was $10.4m (8% of Stamp) with 85% impacting the 2017 year of account and 15% impacting the 2016 year of account.
Destructive wildfires in California presented significant claims activity; not expected to generate material claims beyond HIM estimates.

named_events.event_name: Southern California mudslides / Northern & Southern California wildfires / Mexico earthquakes
named_events.loss_description: The syndicate is not currently expecting these events to generate material claims to the Syndicate.

data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2017 the Syndicate's gross claims outstanding were GBP 54.925m. Analysis of the gross claims development triangle shows a small gross prior-year strengthening of approximately GBP 0.441m (0.80% of opening reserves), driven by adverse re-estimates in the 2015 underwriting year more than offsetting a small release on 2014. The managing agent reports an overall net prior year deficit of GBP 1.8m (net of reinsurance), primarily attributed to a reduction in premium on the casualty reinsurance class. The reserve movement is therefore a modest gross strengthening but a net deterioration after reinsurance.
raw_causal_phrases: In 2017, there has been an overall deficit of GBP 1.8m on prior year reserves (2016:surplus GBP 0.7m).
This has been primarily generated by the reduction in premium on casualty reinsurance class of business.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Gross prior-year development was calculated from the gross claims development table (cumulative gross claims incurred) printed in the report. The managing agent reports a net prior-year deficit of GBP 1.8m (net of reinsurance) - that net figure is explicitly stated but a gross movement note was not provided, so the triangle-derived gross PYD (+GBP 0.441m) is used as the primary measure. Named-event net losses are quoted in USD in the report (e.g. $10.4m for HIM) and have not been converted to GBP for the named_events entries; net loss amounts are therefore set to null when only USD figures are given.
